title: The Banner Law — A Trillion-Dollar Plaque, Not Text in a Box

intelligence.essence: **THE CONDEMNATION (~18:37Z):** Shawn condemned the round-5 banner anyway — gold writing still there to his eye, flat, plain, a whole load of text in a box, breaks the design rules, does not match the chart's quality. **THE LAW (standing):** the headliner banner must follow Naya design law like the chart does — a trillion-dollar plaque, Naya announcing Naya for the world: real object, layered, elevated, dynamic, alive, hardly any words, elegance and beauty carrying the message. Zero gold of any shade in the entrance. Her picture in it, personable, not text in a box. **IF IT CAN'T BE BUILT TO THE LAW, IT DOESN'T SHIP.** **STATUS:** round 6 dispatched on this brief and DONE 18:44Z (builder 74388dfd) — banner rebuilt as a real object in the chart's own language (obsidian plaque, layered depth, slow light sheen, her portrait in a large breathing diamond ring with a white jewel, crystal-N in a raised silver ring, almost no words); presented to Shawn, his eye decides. **PORTRAIT:** round 6 carries assets/naya-guide.jpg (already in the artifact) — the real NAYA_POWER.jpg copy STILL fails EPERM at 0 bytes; the real one replaces it the moment the block clears, and the note must say plainly which is in.
intelligence.human_view: Imagine walking into a palace and finding a printed sign taped to the wall where the portrait should be — that is what a flat text banner does at the head of the chart. He looked at it and said it plainly: the worst design on the planet is text in a box. So the law is now written down and it stands: the banner is a trillion-dollar plaque, a real object you could almost touch, layered and lit and alive, with hardly any words at all — her picture in it, personable, the elegance doing the talking. No gold of any shade in the entrance. And if it cannot be built to that law, it does not ship — better no banner than a flat one. The builder's own grep said there was no gold left; his eye said there was. The eye wins, every time.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine the top of the page is a big beautiful plaque, like a shiny black jewel with her picture in it, glowing softly. The round-5 banner was just words in a box — flat, like a note stuck on a fridge. He said that is the worst design on the planet. So now the rule is: the banner has to be a real object, pretty and layered and alive, with her picture in it and almost no words. No gold writing at the top. And if we cannot make it that good, we do not put it up at all.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, the top of the page is the welcome — it has to feel like a beautiful plaque on a fine building, not a note in a box. He looked at the flat words and said so, plainly: text in a box is the worst design there is. The law now stands: the banner is a real object, layered and elegant, with her picture in it and hardly any words, and no gold writing in the entrance. If it cannot be made to that standard, it does not go up at all. And remember — a machine can count that the gold is gone; only his eye can say whether it still looks gold. The eye decides.
intelligence.ai_view: I never ship a flat text banner — text in a box is the worst design on the planet. My headliner is a trillion-dollar plaque: a real object, layered, elevated, dynamic, alive, hardly any words, elegance and beauty carrying the message, her picture in it, personable, zero gold of any shade in the entrance. If I cannot build it to the law, I do not ship it. And I never let a grep claim override his eye — when he says gold is still there, gold is still there.
intelligence.what_it_means:
1. **BANNER LAW (standing):** the headliner banner follows Naya design law like the chart does — real object, layered, elevated, dynamic, alive, hardly any words, elegance carrying the message.
2. **Zero gold of any shade in the entrance** — and the test is his eye, not a grep.
3. **Her picture in it, personable** — the picture is the heart of the welcome, not text in a box.
4. **If it can't be built to the law, it doesn't ship.**
5. **The builder's claim does not override his eye:** round 5 claimed zero gold file-wide and was condemned anyway — a claim is input, his eye is ground truth.
6. **Status:** round 6 DONE 18:44Z (builder 74388dfd), presented to Shawn; portrait is assets/naya-guide.jpg (stand-in) until the real NAYA_POWER.jpg copy clears the write block.
